sources.notes: Fetched page covers course-selection interviews (Gray's School of Art, Health, Pharmacy, Applied Sciences) and contains nothing about credibility or pre-CAS interviews. Search snippet attributed to rgu.ac.uk described a recorded course-selection video interview: 'You will be asked 6 questions with a time allocation of 4 minutes for each ... read aloud by the interviewer and will also be presented as a transcript on screen'; '7 days to submit your interview ... must complete the interview in one sitting'; 'approximately 60 minutes'. This is an academic selection interview, not a credibility interview - recorded here only so it is not mistaken for one.
